scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:local && wrangler dev --ip 0.0.0.0
scripts.deploy: npm run quality-gate && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
scripts.test:checks: node scripts/formation-registration-type-check.mjs && node scripts/timezone-check.mjs && node scripts/email-cancel-link-check.mjs && node scripts/email-footer-check.mjs && node scripts/required-fields-check.mjs
scripts.test: npm run test:checks && npm run test:ui
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:checks && vitest run --coverage && node scripts/coverage-gate.mjs
scripts.quality-gate: npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test:coverage && npm run security:check && npm audit --audit-level=high
